name: Game Event Mail
description: Mails automatically sent to players of the given races (optionally only those who completed a quest) when a game event starts (positive event id) or stops (negative event id).

fields.name: Event
fields.help: Game event id (game_event.entry), signed. Positive: the mail is sent when the event starts. Negative: the mail is sent when the event stops. 0 is not allowed.

fields.name: Race Mask
fields.help: Mask of player races that receive the mail. Must include at least one playable race.

fields.name: Quest
fields.help: If set, only players who have completed (been rewarded) this quest receive the mail. 0 = no quest requirement.

fields.name: Mail Template Id
fields.help: MailTemplate.dbc id defining the mail's subject and body.

fields.name: Sender Entry
fields.help: creature_template entry shown as the mail sender.
